fullPassage:
Hidden Numbers in Baseball

In baseball, the ball and the bat have hidden numbers that can greatly impact the outcome of a game. A baseball has 108 double stitches, creating raised lines on the ball called seams. The seams help pitchers grip the ball better and transfer more power and spin when throwing it. A spinning ball can change directions in the air because of the air pressure around it. This is called the Magnus effect. The seams make this effect stronger. Pitchers can use this effect to control the ball's direction and speed, creating pitches that are difficult for batters to hit.

While pitchers try to throw challenging pitches by utilizing the ball's seams, batters attempt to make contact with the ball accurately in the hope of hitting a home run. The secret to hitting a home run lies in the baseball bat. The bat's overall length must be less than 106.8 cm long and the diameter of the thickest part must be less than 7 cm. If a player hits the ball about 5-10 cm from the end of the bat, the ball will fly the farthest and give the player the most thrilling and sweetest feeling. That is why this area is called the "sweet spot."

The seams help pitchers (B)[grip / release] the ball better and (C)[transfer / reduce] more power and spin when throwing it. The seams help pitchers grip the ball better and transfer more power and spin when throwing it. A spinning ball can change directions in the air because of the air pressure around it. This is called the Magnus effect. The seams make this effect stronger.

det.korean: 경기 결과에 크게 영향을 미치다(impact). 공을 더 잘 잡다(grip). 더 많은 힘과 회전을 전달하다(transfer).
det.analysis:
✅ ① impact–grip–transfer: 모두 원문 적합
❌ ② affect도 의미상 가능하나 원문은 impact
❌ ③ release(놓다)는 grip(잡다)의 반의어
❌ ④ reduce(줄이다)는 transfer(전달하다)와 반대
det.tip: impact(영향을 미치다) / grip(잡다) ↔ release(놓다) / transfer(전달하다) ↔ reduce(줄이다)

questions.passage:
Hidden Numbers in Baseball

In baseball, the ball and the bat have hidden numbers that can greatly impact the outcome of a game. A baseball has 108 double stitches, creating raised lines on the ball called seams. The seams help pitchers grip the ball better and transfer more power and spin when throwing it. A spinning ball can change directions in the air because of the air pressure around it. This is called the Magnus effect. The seams make this effect stronger. Pitchers can use this effect to control the ball's direction and speed, creating pitches that are difficult for batters to hit.

While pitchers try to throw challenging pitches by utilizing the ball's seams, batters attempt to make contact with the ball accurately in the hope of hitting a home run. The secret to hitting a home run lies in the baseball bat. The bat's overall length must be less than 106.8 cm long and the diameter of the thickest part must be less than 7 cm. If a player hits the ball about 5-10 cm from the end of the bat, the ball will fly the farthest and give the player ____. That is why this area is called the "sweet spot."
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 가장 짜릿하고 달콤한 느낌(the most thrilling and sweetest feeling)을 준다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① the most thrilling and sweetest feeling: sweet spot이라 불리는 이유와 직결
❌ ② strongest impact: sweet spot의 명칭과 무관
❌ ③ accurate throw: 타자가 아닌 투수 행위
❌ ④ highest trajectory: sweet spot 명칭 근거 아님
det.tip: sweet spot → 가장 달콤하고 짜릿한 느낌 → 'sweetest feeling'이 명칭의 근거
